# CITY OF MALDEN
## MASSACHUSETTS

**Liquor Licensing Board**
**Meeting Minutes**
**Date: September 15, 2026**
**Time: 6:00 PM Room 108**

**Members in Attendance:**
- Kevin Molis- Chairman
- Denise Balboni-Cowie
- Andrew Zieberg

**Also in Attendance:**
- Gia Finocchiaro
- Cpt. Paul Hopkins

**Meeting Called to Order:** 6:10 PM
Called to Order By: Kevin Molis
Seconded By: Denise Balboni-Cowie

**Approval of Minutes**: From August 18,2026
Motion: Denise Balboni-Cowie
2nd: Andrew Zieberg

**The following were considered for approval:**

1. The Licensing Board received a New All Alcohol, On-Premises License, from Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC located at 735 Broadway. Esquire Nicholas Zozula from McDermott, Quilty, Miller & Hanley LLP was present along with his client Roman Claverie-Castetnau owner and on-site manager for Urban Soccer. Esq. Zozula presented the proposed license to the board explaining that Mr. Claverie-Castetnau owns multiple locations across France, United States, and Canada. Recently he just opened another location in South Boston that also has a liquor license and has been very successful. Mr. Claverie-Castetnau will be the on-site manager splitting his time between Malden and South Boston location. When Mr. Claverie-Castetnau is in South Boston his assistant manager will be in charge, this person has the same responsibilities as Mr. Claverie-Castetnau. All employees will be T.I.P.S. Certified. Alcohol will not be permitted outside the location on the outdoor fields. Alcohol will only be served in the bar/lounge area and if customer choose to walk to a field to watch a match they will need a wristband (at the boards required condition) showing that they are 21+ and able to consume alcohol.

Esq. Zozula and Mr. Claverie-Castetnau also explained that this is not a bar where patrons will come in only to drink. It is more for while they are there enjoying an event taking place at the arena. Mr. Claverie-Castetnau will also be serving quick food for example; small pizzas, chicken tenders, chips and other food to be consumed.

The board voted to approve the License for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC.
Motion made by Andrew Zieberg, Seconded by Denise Balboni-Cowie.
3 Yea 0 Nay

**Meeting adjourned at**:
Time: 6:47 PM
Motion By: Denise Baldoni-Cowie
Seconded By: Andrew Zieberg
**Minutes respectfully submitted by:** Gia Finocchiaro – Liquor Licensing Clerk
headline: Approved new all-alcohol, on-premises liquor license for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC 3-0.
summary: The board reviewed a new all-alcohol, on-premises license application from Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC at 735 Broadway. Representatives explained alcohol would only be served in the bar/lounge area, with a wristband required for anyone 21+ who wants to bring a drink near the fields. The board voted 3 Yea 0 Nay to approve the license.
decisions: Approved the New All Alcohol, On-Premises License for Urban Soccer (Malden) LLC located at 735 Broadway, 3 Yea 0 Nay.
